//: Project-local Pi settings. Loaded only after you trust this project.
Every key here is a default, not a requirement. `pi config -l` edits this
file interactively; delete anything you do not want.
The one setting worth understanding is `defaultProjectTrust`. It is `ask`,
not `always`: a repository can contain extensions that run code, and
trusting one on sight is how a template checkout becomes arbitrary code
execution. See the security note in docs/agent.md.
